description: Edge cases exercising invalid transitions, duplicate actions, buffer rollover, empty input, duplicate packets, reset, and deterministic replay. Each case specifies the inputs and the exact expected state/behavior so both Swift and TypeScript must agree.

cases.name: empty_input
cases.description: No packets — engine must produce zero counters and pass_percentage 0.0.

cases.name: invalid_transition_from_terminal
cases.description: An ALLOWED packet cannot be transitioned again; the second APPROVE is rejected and counters stay unchanged.

cases.name: duplicate_operator_action_held
cases.description: Two ESCALATE actions on the same held packet: first succeeds, second is rejected as duplicate.

cases.name: buffer_rollover
cases.description: The event buffer has a hard cap (default 300). After exceeding it, older events are evicted FIFO and the total never exceeds capacity.

cases.name: reset_behavior
cases.description: Reset clears all live packets and counters to their initial values while preserving fixture-derived configuration.

cases.name: deterministic_replay
cases.description: Running the same seed twice, step-by-step, produces identical state and metric sequences.

cases.name: score_boundary_safe
cases.description: A packet scoring below 40 (35) auto-passes; a packet scoring exactly 40 is held. Integer weights from the shared contract: port 445=25, payload beacon=10, payload 'SMB negotiate'=5.
